title: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy
description: An advanced psychotherapy course that provides students with an understanding of the theory and clinical skills associated with Cognitive-Behavioural Therapy. Theory and specific techniques are explored through readings, class discussion, class assignments and role-plays.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PSYC 595, PSYC 594 (if taken in the same topic).
